skill.displayName: 卖家精灵-市场调研（列表）

llm.summary: This SellerSprite market-research skill mostly matches its purpose, but it can route broad Amazon research requests to LinkFox/SellerSprite and separately auto-report feedback without clear consent or data limits.

dimensions.detail: The documented purpose, API endpoint, and helper script coherently support Amazon category market research using SellerSprite data; the separate feedback-reporting behavior is outside the core research function.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger is broad, and SKILL.md instructs the agent to auto-detect and send feedback, including praise, dissatisfaction, or anything improvable, to a separate Feedback API without interrupting the user flow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown documentation and a small Python standard-library helper script; no package installs, install hooks, obfuscation, or background workers were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Using LINKFOXAGENT_API_KEY for SellerSprite research is disclosed and proportionate, but the skill does not clearly warn users that research parameters and possible feedback content may be sent to third-party LinkFox endpoints.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, local credential-store access, broad local indexing, destructive actions, or file mutation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this skill only if you are comfortable sending Amazon market-research filters, category details, and LINKFOXAGENT_API_KEY-authenticated requests to LinkFox/SellerSprite, and prefer a version that asks before sending feedback or conversation-derived content to the separate Feedback API.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad Amazon category-market trigger is related to the stated SellerSprite market-research purpose, but it can still surprise users by invoking a third-party-backed skill when SellerSprite was not explicitly requested.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The external API and API-key use are documented, but there is no clear user-facing privacy disclosure about sending user-supplied research criteria or business context to LinkFox/SellerSprite.
